date_claims.meaning: The Health minister's 1988 statement that the provincial government and the medical community established the B.C. Transplant Society in 1985; a retrospective account, not a registration
date_claims.locator: Hansard, 27 April 1988, printed p. 4096, statement of Minister Dueck
date_claims.summary: Competes with the Corporate Registry registration of 1 April 1986 (S0021154) and the 2007 news release's 1986. Kept as a claim; neither is chosen here.

records.note: Round 4 (health module, R4HC-002 to R4HC-006): the 1987-1991 sources describe the Pacific Organ Retrieval for Transplantation (PORT) program as funded by the Ministry of Health, initiated by and part of the Transplant Society. None shows PORT as a registered corporate name. The 1987 statement names a "B.C. Heart Transplant Society", unresolved. The program is a program, not this body's founding.

review.scope: Hansard 27 Apr 1987, 27 Apr 1988, 9 Jun 1988; J Clin Invest April 1991

Reg. 135/97)
research_events.locator: PDF p. 32 / printed p. 27, FOIPPA Schedule 2 row
research_events.summary: Schedule-name history only. Not the board's creation, not the date its name changed under the Hospital Act, and not the date regional health boards or councils entered FOIPPA.

records.note: Round 4 (R4HC-008): the FOIPPA Schedule 2 entry was renamed with effect from 21 April 1997. That date shows the new name in a statute by then; the Hospital Act rename itself is not dated. The 1997 dates must not be used for the regional health boards and councils (13 July 1995).
